content: Chroma: true embedded-mode (in-process, pip install, <5 lines) plus optional single-container server mode (FastAPI backend), auto-embedding via pluggable embedding functions. Qdrant: REST+gRPC, strong filtering API, best concurrent-write handling. Weaviate: largest feature set (GraphQL, multi-tenancy, built-in hybrid search, auto-vectorization modules) but heavier/less embeddable. Embedded-first + REST-server-optional matches Databasise's embeddable posture better than Weaviate's module-heavy model.
